environment: Real native IndexedDB, session storage and MV3 worker.

checks.name: Actual v4→v5 migration preserves old task text and browser source
Native material deletion invalidates completed searches and removes the source
Actual stale-editor UI preserves the draft, shows the latest text and saves only after explicit review
Actual sidebar-to-workspace handoff preserves material/window IDs and Escape closes the detail
Real alarm removes an already-expired draft and retains a current draft
Session draft survives an actual worker restart and clear-all deletes it
